summary: Changes requested. The route/controller/view work is correct and all four ACs are behaviourally met (I probed the read-only claim rather than trusting the notes: POST /admin/sla and /admin/sla/seed-defaults as is_admin return 403 with no session AND with current_tenant_id set to a Business tenant, 0 rows written; GET /admin/sla/tier/basic/edit 403s). 67 tests green, pint clean. Two findings block, both small.

findings.finding: The recorded reason for the 403 is wrong. EnsureTenantSession::handle() (app/Http/Middleware/EnsureTenantSession.php:20-28) short-circuits on $user->isAdmin() -- forgetParameter('slug') then $next($request) -- before it ever looks up the slug, so it never evaluates Tenant::RESERVED_SLUGS for a platform admin. The refusal actually comes from the tenant group's feature:sla_management / checkPermission('create sla policies'): the request IS matched by {slug}/sla and dispatched into SlaPolicyController, and the is_admin bypass in Controller.php is admin.*-only so it does not apply on the tenant route name. Fix the docblock to the measured cause and tighten assertContains([403,404,405]) to assertForbidden() -- the status is deterministic in both session states, I checked both. The range passes regardless of which gate holds, so it would stay green if someone later granted platform staff a tenant role and the write went live. The assertSame(0, ...count()) half is correct and is what carries the test.

The admin manual section 9.2 still says 'Click Create Policy to establish response time targets per priority' and embeds Figures 26/27 (26_create_sla_policy.png, 27_edit_sla_policy.png) for controls this branch deletes. Your notes flag 22/23; the live manual actually uses 26/27, produced by scripts/generate_all_screenshots.js:176-182 and .cjs:162-168 which navigate /admin/sla/tier/{tier}/edit (now 403). Only tests/e2e/generate-manual-screenshots.spec.ts was updated. AC4: a platform admin opening /admin/help is told in writing to click a button that is gone, on the page you just added 'this page is read-only' copy to. Rewrite 9.2 to point at the workspace + Impersonate and drop the two figures. The other stale scripts/* one-off captures (recapture_3_screenshots.js:68, generate_playwright_docker.js:214-220, capture-all-manual-screenshots.js:156, generate-manual-screenshots.js:173) can be left -- just say so.

exportCSV() JS reads const url = '{{ route('admin.sla.export') }}' then if (url !== '#') -- with the Route::has() fallback gone the URL is never '#', so the ~18-line client-side CSV fallback is unreachable, and its header list has no Workspace column so it would contradict the server export if it ever ran. Delete the else branch.

The docblock now claims the admin half 'writes nothing' but the new test asserts only Route::has() for nine names -- and per finding 1 the POST is still matched and dispatched into the controller, so route registration is not evidence of that claim. Either name AdminSlaReadOnlyTest::test_posting_to_an_admin_sla_write_url_is_refused_and_writes_nothing in the docblock the way you already delegate the cross-tenant half to TenantIsolationGuardrailsTest, or fold a row-count assertion in here.
